sources.note: 2026-06-18 steering post: skills, hooks, rules, subagents

findings: CLAUDE.md is always-on, high context cost, and is re-read after compaction. Keep facts and never-do-X only.
Skills: name+description at start; body on invoke; progressive disclosure; they share the token budget.
Subagents: isolated context; return summaries. Use when a dump would flood the parent. Explore/Plan skip CLAUDE.md.
Hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop/SessionStart) are mandatory and cost zero model tokens.
Slash commands are user-typed; skills are model-invoked.
Compaction clears older tool outputs first; conversation instructions may be lost; project-root CLAUDE.md survives.
AGENTS.md is always-on. Load order: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md then the repo chain; AGENTS.override.md wins per level.
Skills use progressive disclosure from ~/.agents/skills and repo .agents/skills.
MCP, subagents, and plugins are complementary, not substitutes for AGENTS.md facts.
Rules: always / glob / agent-requested. Always-on rules cost every turn.
Skills are on demand; .cursor/skills plus Claude/Codex compatibility paths.
AGENTS.md is read. CLAUDE.md is not Cursor-native.
MCP tools load on demand (2.4+).
AGENTS.md is global at ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md plus nested project files. CLAUDE.md is a fallback if no AGENTS.md.
Skills via the skill tool; .opencode/skills and ~/.config/opencode/skills.
Skills: ~/.grok/skills, ~/.agents/skills, plus Claude/Cursor compat. Name+description is the trigger.
AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md are always-on per directory. Hooks block or correct. Subagents own context.
Sessions: ~/.grok/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<id>/summary.json + chat_history.jsonl. Skip synthetic_reason.

sources.note: Local session index is the observability surface

findings: A local session index plus evals beats loading transcripts into the model.
LangSmith-style tracing is out of scope for this skill.
